entities.text: Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Mr.Killedar, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Petitioner fairly stated that he is only pressing the above Petition in terms of prayer clause (c).

After hearing Mr. Killedar for some time as well as the learned AGP for the State, we dispose of the above Writ Petition by requesting the Principal Secretary (Respondent No.5) to take a decision on the communication addressed to him by the NHAI dated 5 th September, 2023 on or before 1st March, 2024.
3
The Writ Petition is disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
4 We make it clear that we have not granted any stay on the demolition and the authorities concerned shall be entitled to take action for demolition in accordance with law.
This order will be digitally signed by the Private Secretary/ Personal Assistant of this Court.
All concerned will act on production by fax or email of a digitally signed copy of this order.
[SOMASEKHAR SUNDARESAN, J.] [ B. P. COLABAWALLA, J.]
